key_impacts: A 16-year-old student was swept away and killed in Kedarnath.
Many others were swept away by the Mandakini River flooding.
Relatives were reported missing after the floods in Kedarnath, affecting family livelihoods.
evidence_snippets: On 17th June 2013, the Mandakini river swept across Kedarnath swallowing Anil along with many others.
June 2013 floods and landslides in Uttarakhand… one of the most debilitating disasters.
Her brother-in-law went missing after the floods and landslide in Kedarnath.
missing_information: Exact numbers of dead and missing are not provided.

key_impacts: The school building was destroyed, reduced to rubble.
School operations shifted to two makeshift locations for two weeks.
From 13 August, classes moved to the Panchayat premises where dank conditions impeded teaching and learning.
evidence_snippets: The July 13 landslide has transformed this school's building into a pile of rubble.
The two weeks after the catastrophe were… chaotic and the school had to be operated from two makeshift locations.
From 13th August onwards, this school was shifted to the premises of the Panchayat… dank premises proved a major impediment.
